pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with high-contrast, angular boundaries. Edge gradients are sharp, exhibiting irregular serration. Patch size increases from the neck toward the flank with increasing geometric complexity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting light-tan pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections. Corridor thickness remains relatively uniform across the visible cervical and thoracic regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal-cervical midline, representing the terminal ends of the mane hair against the background.
